arguments.argument: The passage only states that Mr. Venn was questioned for two days, not when he was first brought before a judge.
arguments.quote: Ms. Brask reminded the court that Mr. Venn had been arrested at his home before dawn on 14 February 2025 and was questioned by police for two days.

arguments.argument: The record does not show when Mr. Venn was first brought before a judge, only when the monitor met him.
arguments.quote: She stated that she was first able to meet Mr. Venn on 21 February 2025, a week after his arrest.
